3464.title: Cache creation detail is lost in provider usage
3464.rootCauseOneLine: Claude combines cache reads and writes; Codex projects away writes; the shared usage schema cannot retain them.
3464.proposedFix: Define and propagate cache creation semantics through the shared contract, provider adapters, and aggregation with compatibility tests.
3464.caveats: Synthetic provider payloads; live billing and reported percentages unverified. Shared schema/protocol change excluded from automatic simple fixes.
